mapper.sql: select a.area_id, a.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, a.area_code, a.area_name, a.area_type, a.status, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from wms_area a left join wms_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = a.warehouse_id
mapper.insert: insert into wms_area (warehouse_id, area_code, area_name, area_type, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{warehouseId}, #{areaCode}, #{areaName}, #{areaType}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update wms_area set warehouse_id=#{warehouseId}, area_code=#{areaCode}, area_name=#{areaName}, area_type=#{areaType}, status=#{status}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark} where area_id=#{areaId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from wms_area where warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} and area_code=#{areaCode} and area_id != #{areaId}
select count(1) from wms_location where area_id=#{areaId}
